## WORK-K3-CORRELATED-QUADRATIC-GAINS

**Construct two independent gains on one quadratic cover**

**Disposition:** proposed. **Kind:** research. **Compute class:** none.

**Next step:** Solve a different shared-branch identity with the genus condition imposed coefficientwise. The new sufficient polynomial chart is x_i^3+A*x_i+B=d*r_i^2 for one squarefree quartic d, deg(x_i),deg(r_i)<=4, x_1!=x_2 and branch disjoint from the parent discriminant; any solution gives two independent height8 directions and arithmetic-genus5 images. It remains unsolved and is not a complete carrier family. Alternatively treat singular genus-two carriers through the retained genus-nine halving-locus theorems, including their exceptional charts and rational-normalization gates. Same-Mestre substitution on Q80, Curve302 MW17 and X1092 class1 is now closed for all rational u. Require an actual positive-rank genus-one base or rational parametrization before claiming the infinite family. No enumeration or rational-point campaign is scheduled.

**Completion evidence:** Two exact independent sections modulo the inherited subgroup on one quadratic cover of the original parameter field, constructed without desired exceptional-point fitting, with a rational covering base or a certified positive-rank genus-one covering base and valid specialization hypotheses. A finite miss does not complete the objective.

**Prerequisites and boundary:** All 300 frozen smooth-pencil pairs and all 1,675 frozen one-node/smooth pairs are excluded over their complete rational parameter spaces. The explicit Mestre pair has height matrix diag(24,24), but genus21; its entire rational auxiliary-function family has genus at least9. Preserve the original degree-two requirement, exceptional-point quarantine, constant squareclasses and the distinction between a rational singular point and a rational point of the normalization. Other carrier identities and arithmetic sources remain open; different-NS equation work still requires its rational marking gate. The136 fixed shared-ordinate tangent pairs also force genus at least86. The earlier published-R17 finite carrier banks do not exhaust that parent's trace parities. The complete63917 direct11952 alternate-Q80 norm8/pole-order-zero pencils now have pairwise disjoint rational branch images, with within-pencil injectivity also certified. Other parent/layer combinations retain their exact untested scopes. The full49 norm12 pencils now extend this to every smooth genus-one bisection on alternate Q80 modulo inherited translation. The written nef/translation classification and98 independently verified new frames close all3133109 additional pairs. A genus-one quadratic solution there must include at least one singular image of arithmetic genus at least2; a rational singular point alone is not a rational point of its normalization. The sharp Mestre cancellation gate now covers direct11952 Q80, Curve302 MW17 and X1092 class1 as well as R17. All four force twenty coefficient branch points for every rational auxiliary function. The genus-nine node-locus result is prior work, not a newly open rational parametrization problem. The different common-quartic chart and its height proof supply no actual cover yet.
